name: Messaging
description: Relays incoming SMS and incoming calls to the host.

settings.label: Call types to relay
settings.help: Missed is in the default because on an unattended unit a missed call is the event actually worth alerting on. Outgoing is excluded unless you pick all.

settings.label: Poll interval
settings.help: How long a message can sit before the host sees it. Calls are sampled on the same tick.

settings.label: Include message bodies
settings.help: Turn off to relay only sender and timestamp. The host then knows a message arrived without the content ever leaving the phone.

settings.label: Spool cap
settings.help: Oldest events are dropped past this. Bounds disk use if the host stops draining; the drop is counted and exported.

settings.label: Backfill on first run
settings.help: How many existing entries to relay when the cursor is first initialised. 0 means start from now, which is almost always what you want.

actions.label: Check the collector can read its sources
